name: Primary Supplier Delay with Low Plant Cover
description: Primary supplier SUP-001 delayed 10 days for SKU-1042 at Chennai Plant SITE-CHN-01. Plant cover is only 4 days. Alternate supplier SUP-004 is qualified and can deliver in 5 days.
report_text: URGENT DISRUPTION REPORT: Primary supplier Apex Micro Systems (SUP-001) reports a 10-day delay in wafer production affecting shipment SHP-8801 of 1200 units of SKU-1042 destined for Chennai Electronics Manufacturing Plant (SITE-CHN-01). Severity: 4.
test_purpose: Alternative supplier path, cheapest viable option selected.
